newsitem.title: USA: MCN unit to sell Gulf of Mexico venture.
newsitem.headline: MCN unit to sell Gulf of Mexico venture.

text.p: MCN Corp said Tuesday its MCNIC Oil & Gas Co unit will sell its 60 percent interest in a Gulf of Mexico joint venture with McMoRan Oil & Gas Company to Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners L.P. for $31.0 million.

The sale includes interests in two fields currently producing about 14 million cubic feet equivalent of gas daily day, net to MCNIC Oil, the company said. The deal is expected to close in the third quarter.

"We accepted this opportunity to monetize a portion of our Gulf of Mexico properties while we continue to aggressively seek new partnerships in the offshore region," MCNIC Oil & Gas Vice President Tom Neel said in a statement.

"Freeport-McMoRan's unsolicited offer yields an attractive return on our overall investment in this exploration program. The proceeds will help us pursue other promising offshore drilling opportunities," he said.

MCNIC Oil & Gas said it expects to invest more than $450 million in drilling and property-acquisition projects during 1997, up about 20 percent from capital investments of $382 million made during 1996. MCNIC Oil & Gas had more than 1.2 trillion cubic feet equivalent of proved reserves at the end of 1996.
